newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to head lower at the open Tuesday, shrugging off yesterday's late rally as investors turn their attention back to interest rates and the March 25 FOMC meeting.
Analysts said that if the long bond yield were to top seven percent, it would cause a considerable lurch in the stock market.
"We're not out of the woods yet," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "What you saw in the final hours yesterday was a short-covering rally in Chicago."
